event: Dan Ballard scores for Sunderland against Arsenal.

passages.text: We head to Sunderland for the first time in eight years on Saturday (5.30pm), looking to increase our lead at the top of the Premier League table and create more history in the process.
passages.title: Preview: Sunderland v Arsenal | Arsenal FC Official Website | Arsenal.com

passages.text: We must look out for Nordi Mukiele’s long throws [above], and mark Hale End academy graduate Dan Ballard very closely as he has had nine headed shots in 2025/26, second only to Erling Haaland. The diminutive Enzo Le Fee is skilful in wide areas, and our shooting will also need to be clinical against Robin Roefs, who has an 81% save accuracy, preventing 2.7 extra goals.

passages.text: One day in 2016, a 16-year-old Daniel Ballard was lying in bed when his phone lit up. He left it ringing, thinking he’d return the call later.
passages.title: Dan Ballard on Sunderland’s flying start, what he owes Ar...

passages.text: He wasn’t having the easiest of times, having been released by Arsenal before suffering a broken ankle, which caused other trials to fall through.
passages.title: Dan Ballard on Sunderland’s flying start, what he owes Ar...

passages.text: Now he was fit again, he was pursuing a scholarship with his home town club Stevenage, in League Two, though that wasn’t a sure thing either. He had even already signed up to return to school and do his A-levels.
passages.title: Dan Ballard on Sunderland’s flying start, what he owes Ar...

passages.text: So that evening, he could have been forgiven for letting the phone ring and dealing with it later. But at the last moment he looked at the screen and saw the call was from Andries Jonker, Arsenal’s academy director.
passages.title: Dan Ballard on Sunderland’s flying start, what he owes Ar...

passages.text: “Andries said: ‘We have a friendly away at Bayern Munich and we need an extra player. Just for this occasion.’
passages.title: Dan Ballard on Sunderland’s flying start, what he owes Ar...

passages.text: “Suddenly I was on the plane to Germany. I played centre-back, played one half and had a really good game. Then, as we were in the airport on the way back, Andries offered me a scholarship. It was a crazy few months.”
passages.title: Dan Ballard on Sunderland’s flying start, what he owes Ar...

passages.text: Looking back, the Sunderland defender understands why they let him go in the first place.
passages.title: Dan Ballard on Sunderland’s flying start, what he owes Ar...

passages.text: “I wasn’t very strong, fast, or technically the best, but I always worked really hard,” he said.
passages.title: Dan Ballard on Sunderland’s flying start, what he owes Ar...

passages.text: “That’s why I think I got that second opportunity, as I always listened and wanted to get better.”
passages.title: Dan Ballard on Sunderland’s flying start, what he owes Ar...

passages.text: In fact, it was the second time he returned to the club, as former academy director Liam Brady had given him a second chance after initially being released.
passages.title: Dan Ballard on Sunderland’s flying start, what he owes Ar...

passages.text: Returning to the club for a second time, he still had to rely mostly on his determination and drive.
passages.title: Dan Ballard on Sunderland’s flying start, what he owes Ar...

passages.text: “I had so much work to do to get up to the standard. I was doing lots of gym work, every session working really hard,” he said.
passages.title: Dan Ballard on Sunderland’s flying start, what he owes Ar...

passages.text: “There was one year I stepped up to the Under-21s, and things started to come together a bit, as I was performing well with them and also started getting opportunities to go on loan.”
passages.title: Dan Ballard on Sunderland’s flying start, what he owes Ar...

passages.text: Stints at Swindon, Blackpool, and Millwall followed, with Ballard moving up a division each year, which gave him the chance to develop away from the spotlight. Meanwhile, he had also begun playing for Northern Ireland, which boosted his club career, before moving to Sunderland in 2022.
passages.title: Dan Ballard on Sunderland’s flying start, what he owes Ar...

passages.text: He recognised the club’s potential and that feeling proved to be right, as they slowly built their way back to the big time, with Ballard eventually playing a key role.
passages.title: Dan Ballard on Sunderland’s flying start, what he owes Ar...
